title: Data root marker (cvac.yaml)
description: Marks a directory as a cv-as-code data root. Everything the framework reads or writes for a user lives under it: users/<slug>/, jobs/, and optional i18n/ and templates/ overrides. See ADR-0006.

default_user.description: Slug of the user commands act on when --user is omitted; must be a users/<slug>/ directory
